items.stem: 다음 중 단어와 뜻이 <u>잘못</u> 연결된 것은?
items.explain: exhibit는 '전시하다'(동사). '전시회'는 exhibition.

items.box:
Alex: Hi, Kate. What are you going to do this weekend?
Kate: I'm going to visit Jeju-do with my family.
Junho: Oh, my grandparents live there. Jeju-do is so beautiful.
Kate: Really? This is my first trip to Jeju-do. I'm so excited.
Alex: What are you going to do there?
Kate: I'm going to see dolphins. I'll also hike Hallasan.
Junho: You should visit a horse park and ride a horse, too. It's really fun.
Kate: ____________________ I'll visit there, too.
Junho: Jeju-do is an amazing place. Have a nice trip!

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Kate는 제주도에 여러 번 가 봤다.
Kate는 승마 공원에 가지 않을 것이다.
items.explain: Oh, my grandparents live there.(Junho) / Kate는 첫 여행이고 가족과 가며, 한라산 하이킹과 승마 공원 방문도 Kate가 한다.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: Junho의 제안(You should visit a horse park ~)에 동의하고 '나도 거기 갈게'로 이어지므로 That's a good idea.

items.stem: 다음 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 말은?
items.box:
• The ______ is very high.
• Yi Sun-sin was a great ______.
• They had a great ______ in Boseong.
• My father grew this ______ in the garden.
items.explain: cliff / admiral / experience / radish 순서로 들어간다. battle(전투)은 들어갈 자리가 없다.

items.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 나머지 4개와 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: My good habit is <u>getting</u> up early.
I like <u>going</u> fishing with my dad.
items.explain: ⑤는 「be동사+-ing」 현재진행형의 현재분사. 나머지는 동명사(①② 보어, ③ 주어, ④ 목적어).
items.source: 학습지 L5 Grammar Points 2 · 선생님 제작

items.stem: 다음 중 문법적으로 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
• Mina wants to be a movie star.
• They enjoyed to swim in the river.
• I think that the painting is very unique.
• She hopes to is a famous pianist.
• Lucy finished to make a robot.
items.explain: 옳은 것: Mina wants to be ~ / I think that the painting ~ (2개). enjoyed to swim → enjoyed swimming, hopes to is → hopes to be, finished to make → finished making.
items.source: 학습지 L6 Grammar Points 2 · 선생님 제작

items.stem: 다음 대화문을 읽고 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 고르시오.
items.box:
G: What do you think about this painting?
B: It's very peaceful.
G: Right. I like the green colors.
B: I think the artist really loved ______.
G: I think so, too.
items.explain: 초록색(green colors)이 평화롭다는 대화 → the artist really loved nature.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 나머지 4개와 <u>다른</u> 것은?
choices: I believe <u>that</u> many students will love the painting.
Do you know <u>that</u> Matisse created this artwork?
I know <u>that</u> is my sister's bag.
I hope <u>that</u> Dean likes this gift.
The important thing is <u>that</u> he likes you.
items.explain: ③의 that은 '저것'을 뜻하는 지시대명사(that is ~의 주어). 나머지는 명사절을 이끄는 접속사 that.
items.source: 학습지 L6 접속사 that · 선생님 제작

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 알맞게 짝지은 것은?
items.box:
• He wanted to (A)______ his emotions with bright and wild colors.
• Matisse (B)______ me in a unique way.
items.explain: express one's emotions(감정을 표현하다) / created me in a unique way(창조했다).

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 <u>어색한</u> 것은?

box.title: My Room
lines: Hi! This is my room. I like my room because it is small and cozy. ⓐ<u>There is a big window next to my bed.</u> ⓑ<u>There are two pictures on the wall.</u> ⓒ<u>Read books in my room is my hobby.</u> ⓓ<u>I enjoy listening to music here, too.</u> ⓔ<u>I want to go to bed early tonight.</u> This room is my favorite place.

items.explain: ⓒ 동사 Read는 주어가 될 수 없다 → 동명사 Reading books ~ is my hobby. ⓐ is+단수, ⓑ are+복수, ⓓ enjoy+동명사, ⓔ want+to부정사는 모두 옳다.

items.box: Junho: Look at this exhibition poster. ⓐWhat do you think about this painting? Minji: ⓑI think it's beautiful. Alex: It's The Starry Night by Vincent van Gogh, right? Junho: Right. I like this painting. The colors of the night sky are amazing. Alex: I think so, too. Junho: Look! The van Gogh exhibition is going on at Mirae Museum. ⓒHow about go there together? Alex: ____________________ ⓓI want to see van Gogh's paintings. Minji: We can also learn about his life and art in the exhibition. Junho: ⓔWhen can we go? It ends on October 1st. Alex: Let's go there this Saturday then. Minji: That sounds great.

items.stem: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 <u>어색한</u> 것은?
items.explain: How about 뒤에는 동명사 → How about going there together?

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: 함께 가자는 제안에 '보고 싶다'로 이어지므로 동의 표현 That's a great idea!

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 세 사람은 반 고흐의 「해바라기」 포스터를 보고 있다.
세 사람은 이번 주 일요일에 전시회에 갈 것이다.
Minji는 전시회에 가고 싶어 하지 않는다.
items.explain: The colors of the night sky are amazing.(Junho) / 포스터는 「별이 빛나는 밤」, 전시회는 10월 1일에 끝나고, 토요일에 간다.

box.title: Garam's Travel Diary
lines: I got up at six in the morning. It was the first day of my family trip to Tongyeong. I was excited! [A] We arrived at Jungang Market at 1 p.m. There we had Chungmu gimbap for lunch. [B] There was only rice inside the roll! Dad said, "Try the roll with radish and squid. Long ago, fishermen had Chungmu gimbap out at sea." [C] Chungmu is Tongyeong's old name. [D] In the afternoon, we went to Yi Sun-sin Park. There was a huge statue of Admiral Yi. [E] I imagined the great battle right off the coast of Tongyeong. Then we enjoyed taking a walk along the coast. The sunset was beautiful. I closed my eyes. I could feel Admiral Yi's love for the country. Everything was really peaceful.

items.stem: 윗글에서 <보기>의 문장이 들어가기에 가장 <u>적절한</u> 곳은?

box.title: <보 기>
lines: It was a bit spicy but tasty.

items.explain: It = 충무김밥. 아빠의 말(무·오징어와 먹어 보라) 뒤에 '조금 매웠지만 맛있었다'가 이어진다.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Garam got up at seven in the morning.
Garam's family arrived at Jungang Market in the morning.
There was rice, radish, and squid inside the roll.
Long ago, fishermen had Chungmu gimbap out at sea.
Garam's family went to Yi Sun-sin Park in the morning.
items.explain: Long ago, fishermen had Chungmu gimbap out at sea. / 6시 기상, 오후 1시 도착, 롤 안에는 밥만, 공원은 오후.

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 <u>없는</u> 질문은?
choices: What time did Garam get up?
Where did Garam's family have lunch?
How long did Garam's family stay in Tongyeong?
What did Garam see at Yi Sun-sin Park?
items.explain: 여행 기간은 이 글에 나오지 않는다. (6시 / 중앙시장 / 충무 / 이순신 장군의 거대한 동상)

items.box: Hello, everyone. My name is Amélie. Welcome to my husband's gallery. Look at me. Do you think that I'm strange? My husband, Henri Matisse, colored my face in green. Don't worry. My face isn't actually green. Why did he paint me [A]this way then? He wanted to express his emotions with bright and wild colors. People didn't like this painting style at first. Some people thought that a beast painted me. ______, he got the nickname Wild Beast. He kept his own style and finally became famous.

items.stem: 윗글에서 밑줄 친 [A]가 가리키는 것은?
items.explain: 바로 앞 문장 My husband, Henri Matisse, colored my face in green.을 가리킨다.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 자연스러운 것은?
items.explain: 야수가 그렸다고 생각했다 → '그래서' 야수라는 별명을 얻었다. 인과 관계의 So.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 <u>않는</u> 것은?
choices: 마티스는 밝고 거친 색으로 감정을 표현하고 싶어 했다.
마티스는 자신의 스타일을 지켰고 마침내 유명해졌다.
items.explain: People didn't like this painting style at first. → 처음에는 좋아하지 않았다.

box.title: Garam's Travel Diary
lines: Early in the morning, we went to Dongpirang. There were many pretty paintings on the walls. It was the best place for taking pictures! Mom and I took ⓐ<u>hundreds of</u> pictures. Finally, my dad said, "Please stop! No more pictures!" 'Dong' ⓑ<u>means</u> 'east,' and 'pirang' means 'cliff.' There is also Seopirang. Next, we went to the Jeon Hyuck-lim Museum of Art. The painter's ⓒ<u>nickname</u> is 'The Magician of Color.' He painted the sea of Tongyeong with ⓓ<u>various</u> blue colors. I enjoyed his paintings very much. What a great experience! ⓔ<u>Going on a family trip</u> is always fun. Tongyeong, bye for now! See you next time!

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에서 우리말 뜻이 알맞지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
items.explain: various는 '다양한'. '밝은'은 bright.

items.stem: <보기>의 (A)~(D)를 윗글의 흐름에 맞게 순서대로 배열한 것은?

box.title: <보 기>
lines: (A) Garam's family went to the Jeon Hyuck-lim Museum of Art.
(B) Mom and Garam took hundreds of pictures.
(C) Garam's family went to Dongpirang early in the morning.
(D) Dad said, "Please stop! No more pictures!"

items.explain: 아침 동피랑 → 사진 수백 장 → 아빠의 '그만!' → 다음으로 전혁림 미술관.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: There were many pretty paintings on the ground.
Jeon Hyuck-lim's nickname is 'The Magician of Color.'
Jeon Hyuck-lim painted the sea with red colors.
items.explain: The painter's nickname is 'The Magician of Color.' / 그림은 벽에, 'Dong'은 'east', 파란색, 그림을 매우 즐겼다.

items.box: Hi, there. ⓐ<u>Can you find me</u> in the picture? ______, I'm an animal. Start from the green shape in the middle. Then trace the other shapes with your finger. ⓑ<u>They look like</u> a snail shell. Yes, I'm a snail! Matisse created me in a unique way. He painted paper and ⓒ<u>cut out shapes with scissors</u>. Then he put the shapes together and made me. At the age of 70, Matisse got very sick. However, ⓓ<u>he never gave up art</u>. He created a new art form. It's cut-outs. ⓔ<u>Do you want finding more artworks</u> like me? Look around the gallery and explore Henri Matisse's world of art!

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 자연스러운 것은?
items.explain: '나를 찾을 수 있나요? 사실 나는 동물이에요.' → Actually(사실은).

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 <u>어색한</u> 것은?
items.explain: want는 to부정사를 목적어로 쓴다 → Do you want to find more artworks ~?

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 <u>없는</u> 질문은?
choices: How did Matisse make the snail?
What happened to Matisse at the age of 70?
How much does the artwork cost?
What is Matisse's new art form?
items.explain: 작품의 가격은 나오지 않는다. (달팽이 / 종이를 칠하고 오려 합침 / 매우 아팠다 / cut-outs)
